title: Flow connections
intro: The Flow instances Astrolabe reads team capacity and rosters from. Astrolabe only reads from Flow; nothing is ever written back. Administrators manage the connections.
loadFailed: Could not load the Flow connections
notFound: This Flow connection does not exist (or was deleted).

field.baseUrlHint: Flow's address exactly as the operator listed it, for example https://flow.example.com. A capital letter, a default port or a trailing slash is corrected for you.
field.baseUrlFixed: The address is the connection's identity and cannot change. Create a new connection for another Flow.
field.timeZoneHint: The IANA zone (Europe/Warsaw) that turns Flow's sprint and membership instants into dates; use the zone Flow's metrics run in.
field.apiTokenHint: A Flow service token (flow_int_ followed by 43 characters), issued in Flow under Administration. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
field.apiTokenKeep: A token is stored. Leave blank to keep the current token, or enter a new one to replace it.
field.apiTokenMissing: No token is stored. Enter one.
field.pollIntervalHint: How often Astrolabe reads Flow on its own: every 5 minutes up to once a day (1440); a sprint calendar changes a few times a week, so the default is hourly. A connection that is disabled or not yet tested is not polled.

validation.baseUrlInvalid: Enter Flow's address as an origin only: http:// or https://, the host and an optional port, with no path, query or credentials
validation.timeZoneInvalid: Enter an IANA time zone such as Europe/Warsaw (a bare offset such as +02:00 is not one)
validation.apiTokenInvalid: A Flow service token is flow_int_ followed by 43 characters

saveForbidden: Only administrators can manage Flow connections
saveConflict: A connection with this name already exists
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This connection no longer exists — reload the page
deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted with its run history and its copy of Flow's teams, sprints and members, and every link between an Astrolabe team and a Flow team made through it will be unlinked. Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.
deleteBodyNoLinks: “{{name}}” will be deleted with its run history and its copy of Flow's teams, sprints and members. No team was linked in its last read. Nothing is changed in Flow.
deleteBodyLinks_one: “{{name}}” will be deleted with its run history and its copy of Flow's data, and its {{count}} team link will be unlinked. Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.
deleteBodyLinks_other: “{{name}}” will be deleted with its run history and its copy of Flow's data, and its {{count}} team links will be unlinked. Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.

toast.savedRetest: Connection saved. Test it again, the settings changed

test.truncated: Flow cut its document at its limits (1,000 teams, 2,000 sprints). A run keeps what arrived and logs a warning.
test.rateLimited: Too many tests in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
test.failedGeneric: The test could not run. Check your connection and try again.

errorCode.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Flow rejected the token: it was revoked or expired - issue a new one in Flow and update the connection
errorCode.NOT_FOUND: Flow does not serve this endpoint; it needs Flow 1.57.0 or later
errorCode.RATE_LIMITED: Flow is rate limiting this token; try again later
errorCode.TIMEOUT: Flow did not answer in time
errorCode.BUSY: Too many Flow calls are in flight; try again in a moment
errorCode.INVALID_RESPONSE: Flow sent an answer that could not be read
errorCode.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Flow's answer passed a safety limit
errorCode.BLOCKED_HOST: Flow's address is not on the operator's list of allowed origins
errorCode.REDIRECT: Flow answered with a redirect, which is refused
errorCode.TIME_ZONE_INVALID: The connection's time zone is not known to this server; correct it

details.testedBefore: Not tested since the connection was last changed

refresh.invalid: This connection cannot be refreshed (it is disabled or gone)
refresh.alreadyRunning: A refresh is already running for this connection. Its progress shows in the table below.
refresh.running: A refresh is running. The table below updates by itself.

teams.title: Teams
teams.intro: The Flow teams this connection last read. Link each to the Astrolabe team it stands for: a linked team can import its capacity from Flow and shows Flow's roster.
teams.loadFailed: Could not load the Flow teams
teams.emptyHint: No Flow data has been read yet. Use Refresh now above (test the connection first if it has not been tested).
teams.summary: Flow teams: {{teams}} · linked: {{linked}} · with a suggestion: {{suggested}}
teams.disabledNote: The connection is disabled: teams cannot be linked until it is enabled.
teams.unlinkBody: Astrolabe team “{{team}}” will no longer be linked to Flow team “{{flowTeam}}”. Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.
teams.unlinkForbidden: Only administrators or the team's manager can unlink it
teams.unlinkGone: This link no longer exists — it was already removed
teams.linkForbidden: Only administrators or the team's manager can link it
teams.linkConflict: The link conflicts with an existing one
teams.linkInvalid: The link was refused: refresh the connection and try again
teams.matchResult: {{linked}} linked, {{noMatch}} without a unique match, {{already}} linked already.
teams.matchFailed: Could not link the suggested teams
